message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration features a blue background with a white "TEMPO" logo and red banner at the top. The image depicts a person’s head, rendered in shades of purple and pink, tilted back while wearing a blue pleated medical mask. This figure is positioned on the left side, facing upward. A black-gloved hand descends from the upper right, holding a white stick that resembles a medical swab. The swab's handle is interrupted by a white "S" shape, giving it the appearance of a dollar sign. The cotton tip of the swab is positioned directly above the person's nostril. 

Several text blocks are present. Transcribed words include: "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU", "Relawan Jokowi di Balik Bisnis Royalti H.76", "Masa Depan Bumi dalam Perundingan Glasgow H.86", "1-7 NOVEMBER 2021", "RP 45.000", "WWW.TEMPO.CO", "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN", "ISSN: 0126 - 4273", and a large headline on the right: "Para Penikmat Cuan PCR". Below this is a smaller paragraph starting with "Pemerintah bakal memberlakukan syarat tes reaksi berantai polimerase..." and ending with "H.26". A barcode and QR code are in the upper right corner.
